subject: Geopolitics
title: Cold War Information Battle
description: A quick, practical guide to Cold War Information Battle.

hook.text: The US funded Radio Free Europe. The Soviets funded Pravda and Tass.

buildup.text: The Cold War was an ideological contest. Each side promoted its system as superior: capitalism vs communism.

discovery.text: The CIA secretly funded arts, magazines, and cultural events to promote Western values. Soft power was a covert weapon.

twist.text: Soviet propaganda exposed real US failures: racism, inequality, Vietnam.

climax.text: The Cold War proved that ideas are weapons. The side that better told its story won hearts even before winning battles.

punchline.text: The Cold War was fought with weapons and words. Words lasted longer.

quiz.question: Why was Soviet propaganda about US racism effective?
options: It was based on fabricated events
It exposed real failures, making the message credible
American audiences could not access alternative media
